title: Ancient Horse Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Ancient Horse Gear.png |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW |other= |cost= |value= |location= {{List| * [[Malanya Spring]] * [[Satori Mountain]] }} |uses= {{List| * Decorating [[Link]]'s [[Horse]]s * Providing additional spurs on horseback * Horse [[Warping]] }} |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Ancient Horse Gear||Series, BotW}} is an [[Item]] set in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|You found the {{Color BotW|Red|ancient horse gear}} at Satori Mountain and Malanya Spring!

Equip your horse with the Ancient Bridle for a longer-lasting gallop. Equip the Ancient Saddle and your horse will come running whenever you call, no matter how far you are.
Believing those rumors really paid off!|Adventure Log|BotW}} It is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack. ==Features and Overview== Ancient Horse Gear is a matching set of [[Horse Gear]] made of [[Ancient Technology]], and it is composed of the [[Ancient Bridle]] and [[Ancient Saddle]]. When the overworld of [[Hyrule]] is reloaded after leaving the [[Great Plateau]], [[Link]] will receive the "[[EX Ancient Horse Rumors]]" [[Side Quest]], which tasks him with reading a volume of the ''[[Super Rumor Mill EX]]'' located at [[Highland Stable]] for information on Ancient Horse Gear.{{Cite| Rumor has it there's a bridle that enhances a horse's skill and a saddle that can summon your horse right to you. Does this supposed ancient horse gear really exist?

Apparently {{Color BotW|Red|Highland Stable}} has a copy of Super Rumor Mill EX, which details some rumors about this rare horse gear.|Adventure Log|BotW}} Within the ''[[Super Rumor Mill V3]]'', [[Traysi]] describes how the Ancient Saddle is capable of increasing a [[Horse]]'s skills, while the Ancient Bridle can summon a Horse to its rider's side.{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient horse gear is real, and it's FABULOUS!}} Apparently, there's some incredible horse gear from Hyrule's distant past. I'm talking the long, long ago, folks! A bridle that increases your horse's skill and a saddle that can instantly summon your horse to your side.|Super Rumor Mill V3|BotW}} The Ancient Bridle is supposedly hidden under a cherry blossom tree on a mountain where [[Creature]]s gather, while the Ancient Saddle is at a spring that is home to a Horse spirit.{{Cite|The bridle is south of {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule Ridge}}, {{Color BotW|Red|beneath a cherry blossom tree at a mountain where creatures gather}}. The saddle is {{Color BotW|Red|at a mysterious spring where a horse spirit resides}}.|Super Rumor Mill V3|BotW}} Both pieces of Ancient Horse Gear are contained within metallic EX [[Treasure Chest]]s. The Ancient Bridle is on top of [[Satori Mountain]], while the Ancient Saddle is at [[Malanya Spring]]. These Chest must be pulled out of the ground using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Once both have been obtained, the Side Quest will be completed. Ancient Horse Gear can be equipped at Highland Stable, [[Outskirt Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], or [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Ancient Bridle}}?|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Ancient Saddle}}?|Canni|BotW}} However, [[Epona]] and the [[Giant Horse]] are unable to wear it.{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty fine horse you have there. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty fine horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled... I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}} Ancient Horse Gear is the only variety of Horse Gear that grants an effect to the Horse wearing it. The Ancient Bridle provides two additional [[Spur]]s to the Horse that has it equipped.{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Bridle}}
A mysterious bridle made with forgotten ancient technology. Equipping a horse with this will maximize their abilities, increasing the number of spurs associated with them.|Inventory|BotW}} Wearing the Ancient Saddle allows Link to [[Warping|Warp]] his Horse to his side by [[Whistle|Whistling]].{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Saddle}}
A mysterious saddle made with forgotten ancient technology. Equip a horse with this and use Whistle to call them even when they are far away.|Inventory|BotW}} ===List of Horse Gear=== {{Data Table |game= BotW |columns= Horse Gear [Image:Icon:144x144px][Term], Description [Description] | Ancient Bridle {{DLC|TCB}} | ''A mysterious bridle made with forgotten ancient technology.
